subject: 🎉 Placement Confirmed — $job_title at $company_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

Congratulations! Your placement has been confirmed. We're delighted to share the details below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PLACEMENT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Role:           $job_title
Employer:       $company_name
Location:       $location
Type:           $job_type
Start Date:     $start_date
Duration:       $placement_duration
Compensation:   $salary_range
Application ID: $application_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NEXT STEPS

  1. Reply to your employer contact ($employer_contact) to confirm acceptance.
  2. Complete any pre-placement paperwork they request (right-to-work, NDA, etc.).
  3. Register the placement on the Careers portal so your academic record is updated.
  4. Book a pre-placement chat with the Careers team if this is your first role.

Employer notes:
$employer_notes

If anything changes — start date, withdrawal, contract concerns — please tell the Careers team straight away so we can support you.

Wishing you a fantastic placement!

Kind regards,
University Careers Service
